scenes.label: Exercise
full: Children need to exercise every day.
Running, playing football, riding a bike and dancing help make your bones and muscles strong.
easy: Children need to exercise every day.
Running, playing football, riding a bike and dancing help make your bones and muscles strong.

scenes.label: Play outside
full: Vitamin D is important for your bones.
Vitamin D comes from the sun.
It’s good to play outside, but remember to use sun cream when you are in the sun!
easy: Vitamin D is important for your bones.
Vitamin D comes from the sun.

scenes.label: Drink water
full: It’s important to drink a lot of water.
Drink more water when you do exercise and when it’s hot.
easy: It’s important to drink a lot of water.
Drink more water when you do exercise and when it’s hot.
